data.verdict: HONEST NEGATIVE (scope-(a)). The Σ(2,3,5) S-matrix supplies a finite parameter-free palette of magnitude candidates; NONE reproduces all four AME binding ratios simultaneously (coherent gate FAILS for every below-ceiling entry). Two structural findings stand: (1) the RAW vacuum-row entries (2/√5)sin(π/5)=0.526, (2/√5)sin(2π/5)=0.851, 2/√5=0.894 ALL exceed the physicality ceiling 1/√5=0.447 and are excluded — only the vacuum-row NORMALIZATIONS 1/D and the golden 1/φ² survive; (2) the Ê₈ second-flat-connection normalization S_00(ζ²)=1/√(10−2√5)=0.42533 reproduces the ⁴He/D ratio strikingly (12.77 vs AME 12.72, 0.4%), but the SAME m fails the 3-body: it under-predicts ρ_3H (2.9 vs 3.8) and over-splits the ³H/³He mirror (~2.4× vs AME 1.10×). The ⁴He/D near-match is a single-ratio hit across a finite menu (menu-coincidence caution, per the keystone_qhankel discipline), NOT a coherent realisation. The √5 ceiling is a genuine algebraic coincidence with the icosahedral S-matrix eigenvalue, but the exchange magnitude m is NOT one of its vacuum-row entries: this construction, ALONE, does not reproduce the four-isotope magnitudes. Consistent with the map's #3943 finding that the residual is collective/non-additive (the mirror over-split is the sharp diagnostic). No fit; nothing wired.
